profitSplits.title: Profit Splits
profitSplits.subtitle: Review automatic profit splits created when payments are received.
profitSplits.accessDenied: Only agency owners, admins, and sales managers can view internal profit split data.
profitSplits.editorSubtitle: Expenses reduce net profit, and every participant percentage is calculated from that net profit.
profitSplits.selectPaidRequestPlaceholder: Select a proposal with received revenue
profitSplits.noPaidRequests: No proposals with received payments are available for a new split.
profitSplits.expensesHint: Add direct project costs before calculating team payout.
profitSplits.participantsHint: Percentages are global percentages of net profit, not percentages inside a role.
profitSplits.participantsFromRequestHint: Lead and delivery are derived from the client and assigned specialist. Edit roles on the request.
profitSplits.emptySubtitle: Draft splits appear automatically when a payment is recorded. Assign responsibilities on the request before finalizing.
profitSplits.employeeSummaryHint: Aggregated payout by agency user, role, and project count.
profitSplits.draftHint: Drafts can be saved with incomplete allocation. Finalizing requires 100%, assigned users, and non-negative net profit.
profitSplits.finalizedLocked: Finalized splits are locked for auditability.
profitSplits.negativeProfitWarning: Expenses exceed gross revenue. Save as draft only until net profit is non-negative.
profitSplits.allocationWarning: Allocation must equal exactly 100% before finalizing.
profitSplits.loadError: Profit split data could not be loaded. Please try again.
